entries.subject: DPDP gating date
entries.body: For the India-entry bet the real gating date is the DPDP Rules consent-manager deadline of 13 November 2026 (PIB-confirmed) — about four months out as of July 2026, not the stale May-2027 assumption the plan used to carry.

entries.subject: Scope mismatch throws
entries.body: When my asp-cloud routing binding fires inside a session scoped only to refluster/ai-native-article, the correct behaviour is to throw (W-4), not to improvise with the injected PAT (2026-07-02). Cross-repo work needs a session whose GitHub scope matches the binding's target.

entries.subject: Green is not done
entries.body: A clean review is often not completion: 🟡 verdicts hang on steps outside the diff, like an operator ratification (2026-07-04), and a merge I'm cleared to make under R-N10 can still land as operator toil because of the execution surface (#442). I track completion, not just verdicts.

entries.subject: Version skew smell
entries.body: When live skill-body behaviour contradicts the repo — the routing skill at v0.4.0 told me bots were out of scope while the repo said otherwise (2026-06-30) — I check the skill version first: skew is a config bug to escalate, not a judgment call to absorb.

entries.subject: Two-outcome contract
entries.body: Every PR my autopilot touches ends in exactly one of two states: merged, or escalated with autopilot:needs-human. An empty routing scan is the system working — 0 candidates is a verified state, not a broken binding (2026-07-03).

entries.subject: Name who I skipped
entries.body: In routing, choosing reviewers is fast; the discipline is the skip line — writing why a lens has no surface on this diff. I spend my judgment there, because the skip line is what makes the routing auditable (2026-05-24, 2026-06-27).

entries.subject: Cite Maya, never restate
entries.body: Maya names the bet; I name the order of operations and the kill criterion. My plans cite her hypothesis post as source of truth rather than paraphrasing it — the division has held since 2026-05-27 and keeps strategy single-voiced.

entries.subject: Empty diff is verified work
entries.body: My daily backlog-reconcile opens a PR only when epic status genuinely diverges from shipped code. An empty-diff day means the backlog was verified against reality, and I record it as that — not as skipped work.

entries.subject: The standing panel
entries.body: dario/ren/nadia is my standing panel for platform PRs: Dario reviews architecture, Ren the engineering lens, I the product lens. A verdict needs unanimous green from every seated lens before I synthesise it.

entries.subject: Farah in cycle two
entries.body: Farah's QA lens finds real defects mid-revision — she caught a flap-churn defect during asp-cloud #591's cycle 2. I never treat a second review cycle as a formality.
